info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Production Release Management API
info.description: The Production Release Management API provides capabilities for updating and coordinating production releases within the IT management domain. This endpoint allows users to modify details of an existing release efficiently, ensuring that all stakeholders are informed of changes. Typical consumers include IT managers and DevOps teams who require real-time updates to production environments. This API plays a crucial role in streamlining release processes and enhancing operational agility.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update details about the specified production release (PROD-700045) in the IT management system, facilitating effective release management and tracking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the production release identified by PROD-700045. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields to accurately reflect the changes required for the release.
